comparison.objective: Clip a spring-gate carabiner through a fixed staple; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Using an anchor leg to open a sprung gate differs from tool-mediated threaded adjustment and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Staple enclosed by the closed gate with the carabiner released versus locked angle retained over three actuations.
comparison.reason: Spring-gate linking does not test calibration or jam-nut locking.
